card.title: CHURCHILL Mk IV
card.flavorText: The Mark IV Churchill was a British made heavy infantry tank. It was one of the heaviest tanks used by the Allies in WWII, with a crew of 5 (commander, gunner, loader/radio operator, driver, co-driver/hull gunner), and several variations were produced throughout the war. It was slow, but had the ability to cross difficult ground and several variations were produced. The tank was named after British Prime Minister Winston Churchill.
